# Dineiz — Complete Restaurant Point of Sale & Management Platform

> Dineiz is an offline-first, local-first restaurant POS and management ecosystem engineered for restaurants, cafes, dhabas, food carts, cloud kitchens, and multi-branch hospitality groups. Built by Crosiz Technologies, Dineiz combines high-speed touch billing, automated WhatsApp AI ordering in Roman Urdu and English, a real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS), raw ingredient recipe inventory management, multi-terminal cashier reconciliation, thermal/Bluetooth receipt printing, and FBR/GST tax compliance into a unified system that functions 100% offline and syncs instantly when connectivity returns.

For the full-depth technical manual, feature matrix, comparison guides, and AI reference database, see:
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://dineiz.com/llms-full.txt): Complete exhaustive technical specifications, competitive benchmarks, hardware compatibility matrices, and 25+ direct answer Q&As.

## Core Products & Modules

- [Dineiz POS (Tablet & Desktop POS)](https://dineiz.com/product/pos): Touch-optimized point-of-sale terminal for iOS, Android, and Windows. Features visual floor table management, order variation pickers (half/full, custom spice levels), multi-cashier PIN logins, split billing, thermal receipt printing (ESC/POS 58mm/80mm), and local-first outbox synchronization.
- [Dineiz Go (Free Mobile Billing App)](https://dineiz.com/product/go): Ultra-lightweight Android mobile POS designed for food trucks, roadside dhabas, street carts, and quick-service stalls. Requires zero upfront hardware; prints receipts over mobile Bluetooth printers and functions entirely offline.
- [Dineiz WhatsApp AI Ordering](https://dineiz.com/product/whatsapp): Conversational ordering engine powered by natural language AI. Parses customer food orders sent in Roman Urdu, English, or colloquial dialects, generates automated cart drafts, collects delivery details and payment preferences, and routes confirmed orders straight to the kitchen display screen.
- [Dineiz Console (Cloud Back-Office)](https://dineiz.com/product/console): Central web management portal for multi-branch menu engineering, staff permission matrices, real-time live telemetry, hourly sales tracking, raw recipe inventory depletion, and financial reporting.
- [Kitchen Display System (KDS)](https://dineiz.com/features): Paperless digital kitchen display monitor with color-coded preparation timers, order bump bars, station routing (grill, tandoor, barista), and acoustic audio alerts.
- [Features Overview](https://dineiz.com/features): Comprehensive breakdown of all platform modules including inventory stock management, shift drawer audits, and tax fiscalization.

## Industry Solutions & Business Verticals

- [Restaurants & Fine Dining](https://dineiz.com/industries/restaurant): Full table service, interactive visual floor layouts, guest pacing, server assignment, split bills, and kitchen slip synchronization.
- [Cafes, Coffee Shops & Bakeries](https://dineiz.com/industries/cafe): High-speed counter checkout, modifier add-ons (milk alternatives, syrup shots, baking times), barista station KDS sync, and customer loyalty retention.
- [Dhabas & Quick Service Restaurants (QSR)](https://dineiz.com/industries/dhaba): Fast-paced cash billing, heavy rush handling, 100% offline resilience during load shedding, and rapid receipt dispatch.
- [Food Carts, Kiosks & Food Trucks](https://dineiz.com/industries/food-cart): Single-device Android mobile POS with zero capital expenditure, fast tap ordering, and portable Bluetooth battery printing.

## Technical Architecture & Offline Resilience

- **Local-First Outbox Synchronization**: Every ticket, line item, payment, and shift record is saved immediately to local persistent storage (IndexedDB / SQLite) on the device before network transmission. Sales operations never pause during ISP drops or power outages.
- **Auto-Healing Multi-Terminal Mesh**: Changes synchronize automatically with the cloud telemetry broker the instant an internet connection is established, with deterministic conflict resolution.
- **Hardware Agnostic & Peripheral Standards**: Native support for industry-standard ESC/POS thermal receipt printers (Epson, Sunmi, Xprinter, Star Micronics) via USB, LAN/Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth (58mm and 80mm). Integrates with standard RJ11/RJ12 cash drawers and barcode scanners.
- **FBR & Provincial Tax Engine**: Automated calculation and printing of GST/sales tax invoices complying with FBR POS regulations and provincial revenue authorities (PRA, SRB, KPRA, BRA) with NTN and STRN invoice validation.

## Pricing Tiers

- [Dineiz Pricing](https://dineiz.com/pricing):
  - **Go Free (PKR 0 / month)**: Free forever plan for food carts, tea stalls, and small dhabas. 1 cashier, up to 100 orders/mo, offline mobile billing.
  - **Go Pro (PKR 999 / month | ~$3.50 USD)**: Unlimited orders on mobile POS, Bluetooth thermal printing, WhatsApp support, daily sales exports.
  - **Starter (PKR 2,999 / month | ~$10.50 USD)**: Tablet POS, 2 terminals, visual table layouts, digital KDS, recipe inventory management, 14-day free trial.
  - **Pro (PKR 5,999 / month | ~$21.00 USD)**: Unlimited POS terminals, WhatsApp AI ordering engine, multi-branch centralized menu control, advanced inventory variance reports.
  - **Enterprise (Custom)**: Custom multi-location franchise deployments, API integration, dedicated account manager, SLA guarantees, on-site onboarding.
